title: After the vault burns, Sarel says 'Hann's own die is ash and melt now, same as the rest of him' — but the exact reverse die she personally handed me earlier ('She hands it over both-handed... he hands it over') is sitting safely in my pack the whole time, confirmed by its own item text later ('the vault burned through; nothing left to strike — a keepsake', i.e. still intact). She reacts as if her family's die was destroyed when it demonstrably wasn't; nothing distinguishes 'the die I kept' from 'other dies that stayed in the vault' in her line.
where: The Hammer Hearth, Pennywell / talk to Sarel, 'the vault, now it's burned'
